description_en: Creates an intelligent navigation instance, configures the instance name, description, and maximum number of concurrent sessions, and returns the ID of the new instance
description_zh: 创建智能导航实例，设置实例名称、描述和最大并发会话数，并返回新实例的 ID
kebab_example: aliyun voicenavigator create-instance --name '测试场景' --concurrency 1 --api-version 2018-06-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The description of the scenario. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 场景描述。长度不超过 100 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions. The value must be a non-negative integer and cannot exceed the current available concurrency quota
parameters.help_zh: 最大并发会话数。取值为非负整数，不能超过当前可用并发额度
parameters.name: concurrency

parameters.help_en: The integration source of the intelligent navigation. When you integrate with Cloud Call Center, set the value to `CCC` and specify the associated Cloud Call Center instance by using `UnionInstanceId`
parameters.help_zh: 智能导航的集成来源。对接云联络中心时取值为 `CCC`，并通过 `UnionInstanceId` 指定关联的云联络中心实例
parameters.name: union_source

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the integration source. When `UnionSource` is set to `CCC`, specify the ID of the Cloud Call Center instance to be associated
parameters.help_zh: 集成来源方的实例 ID。当 `UnionSource` 为 `CCC` 时，填写需要关联的云联络中心实例 ID
parameters.name: union_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The parameter settings of the natural language understanding (NLU) service, represented as a JSON character string. The parameters correspond to the type of NLU service used
parameters.help_zh: 自然语言理解（NLU）服务的参数配置，使用 JSON 对象字符串表示。参数内容与所使用的 NLU 服务类型对应
parameters.name: nlu_service_params_json

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the newly created intelligent navigation scenario
InstanceId.description_zh: 新创建的智能导航场景 ID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的标识，用于定位和排查请求问题
